title: Fisher–Rao Geodesic Attention: Spherical and Hyperbolic Attention from Information Geometry
description: Preprint source and code for attention mechanisms whose score is the exact Fisher–Rao geodesic distance between distributional token representations: categorical tokens give a spherical kernel and isotropic Gaussian tokens a hyperbolic one, which is hyperbolic distance attention in half-space coordinates computed with one matrix multiplication plus an elementwise arccosh. Includes the Dyck-2 benchmark with 20-seed statistics, a 19M-parameter probe, a pre-registered relative-position (RoPE) test, Wasserstein–Bures and KL/Bregman controls, a positive-definite Laplacian variant, a threshold-gated parameter-efficiency result, pre-registered character-level tests on program source, English prose and Spanish clinical text, pre-registered probes of what the learned scales encode, a comparison with a reimplementation of curvature-adaptive routing (CAT), a re-execution on separate hardware, and pre-specified negative results. All experiments run on CPU. Code under the MIT licence; paper text and figures © the authors.
